note: CaptureRoadmap CP3.6a. Which apps and which SMS addresses count as a bank. Read by BankDirectoryJson; the app falls back to BankDirectory.SHIPPED, which is compiled in rather than an asset, because an unreadable whitelist would stop capture for every bank at once. A wrong identifier here captures nothing and reports nothing, which is indistinguishable from a bank that has not sent anything yet - so every entry carries a 'source' field the reader ignores, saying whether it was read off a real phone. Never write an identifier from a website.
